name: GBZ Phantom X
description: Our flagship gaming rig built for enthusiasts who refuse to compromise on frames.

details.performance: This system is engineered to handle massive workloads without breaking a sweat. It ensures maximum frame rates and seamless multitasking whether you're gaming in 4K or rendering complex 3D scenes.
details.design: Encased in a premium airflow-optimized chassis. We use high-grade materials and customizable RGB lighting to make sure your setup looks as good as it performs.
details.cooling: Thermals are kept strictly under control with aggressive intake fans and a top-mounted liquid cooler. This prevents thermal throttling even during extended marathon sessions.
details.features: Includes Wi-Fi 6E, Bluetooth 5.3, massive Gen4 NVMe storage, and plenty of high-speed USB ports to connect all your peripherals and VR headsets seamlessly.
